plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-15 by live browser from Bakersfield College's official Program Pathways Mapper (https://programmap.bakersfieldcollege.edu/; no login required or attempted). Program page states 'Catalog 2026-2027' (the transfer map itself is the year=2026 map and prints no '2026-2027' heading, disclosed here). The program page lists FOUR transfer pathways for this AS-T, each printed as 60 units / 4 terms, named for their CSU Bakersfield concentration (General Business, Accounting, Management, Marketing). This plan transcribes ONLY the first pathway, to CSU Bakersfield General Business, and ONLY its Bakersfield College portion (the AS-T itself). The same map page also prints a post-transfer CSU Bakersfield bachelor's portion (60 units, 4 terms at CSUB); that is a different institution's degree and is NOT part of this plan. The other three pathways were not transcribed and remain pending. The map prints the BC portion total as a range, 60-62 units, and Term 1 as 16-18 units. Two Term 1 slots print ranges: 'Statistics' (4-4.5 units) and 'Area 1A: English Composition' (3-4.5 units). Per the standing minimum-credit convention they are recorded at 4 and 3 respectively, so every term sum equals the map's printed term total at its minimum (16 / 14 / 15 / 15) and the plan total is the printed minimum of 60 units. General-education, Statistics and CSU Transferable Elective slots are transcribed exactly as printed as unselected 'Choose a course from ...' choice slots; the three CSU Transferable Elective slots print at 1, 2 and 3 units in Terms 2, 3 and 4 respectively, as recorded. The map prints a 'Prerequisites' flag on BSAD B2 but does not print the specific prerequisite courses, so no prereqs are recorded. Milestone headings printed on the map (Meet with your Counselor, Begin Math Sequence, TAG Application, and the by-semester milestones) carry no course content and are not encoded. The map states it represents one possible pathway through the program and may not reflect the most current catalog requirements, and advises students to make an appointment to create a customized education plan.
